canonical_claim: For the classical complex GL(n) Higgs-bundle system on a suitable smooth projective curve, the characteristic-coefficient Hitchin map is an algebraically completely integrable system on the appropriate stable/regular locus: its Hamiltonians commute, and its generic smooth spectral-curve fiber has the expected Jacobian-type abelian geometry and half dimension.

scope_boundary.data: a smooth projective complex curve, a positive rank n, an appropriate stable Higgs-bundle moduli locus, the Hitchin base, and characteristic/spectral-curve data
scope_boundary.hypotheses: the exact genus, degree, stability, smoothness, regularity, and coprimality conditions required by the selected primary-source theorem
scope_boundary.conclusion: the precisely sourced GL(n) Hitchin map has commuting Hamiltonians and the generic spectral-curve fiber/dimension properties constituting algebraic complete integrability
scope_boundary.excluded: trace-free or other reductive-group variants unless separately transported, singular spectral curves, compactified fibers, parabolic/wild Higgs bundles, and projection from assumed integrability fields

degenerate_cases: Rank one must be checked against the chosen moduli and fiber formulation rather than silently excluded.
Low-genus curves may violate the standard stability or dimension hypotheses and require explicit treatment.
The discriminant locus has singular spectral curves and is not interchangeable with the generic smooth locus.
GL(n) characteristic coefficients must not be replaced by the trace-free SL(n) base.
